decision: Adopt the final candidate: no lane stall or light-load collapse in matched repeats, 2G/5G delivery up 22-116% in most directions; four-flow L->R at 5G falls 7-14% because the left busiest worker saturates while R->L doubles.

conditions.build: release, --features bin,uuid-compat; production 781d064 used all features of that tree, which had no trace feature
conditions.order: for each of three repeats: production then candidate, each running f4-l0, f16-l0, f4-l1, f16-l1 with fresh daemons
conditions.isolation: no local build or test during load; Linux 7.0 kernel tests ran on a separate host

first.candidate: local unsampled retirement, no packet-number consumption on refusal, DATA/control/probe headroom; without the half-history retirement trigger or refreshed-DATA headroom (sha256 86171c70a4af5c9ce2b71c0bb25713d42b73a5cc00c2a3d2fbf6ee1aa6a3ec06)
